description: Mac OS Roman with the Euro at 0xDB and the Apple logo at 0xF0
notes: 0xDB was CURRENCY SIGN before Mac OS 8.5 and EURO SIGN after; the pinned ROMAN.TXT (revision c02) says Euro, and so does every current source. 0xF0 is Apple's logo, which has no Unicode character and maps into the private use area at U+F8FF.
